Title: One on One with Klaus Mitchell

Description.Html:
Dr. Greger talks to Klaus Mitchell, an author whose work has been featured in publications such as BioNews and academic journals like Public Health Nutrition (PubMed ID: 25683748).

His passion for health began during his time at university, where he studied Human Biosciences (BSc) and graduated as the top of his year in 2013. He later earned an MSc in The Genetics of Human Disease from University College London, graduating with distinction on a full scholarship.

Today, Klaus is the Founder and CEO of Plant Based News, an award-winning media platform with nearly 4 million followers across social media and 80 million monthly impressions.

In his spare time, Klaus is a dedicated sustainability advocate and actively supports initiatives like spreading PCRM’s Food for Life programme in underserved North London communities, helping to promote health and nutrition where it’s needed most.

This episode features audio from ACCELERATE WEIGHT LOSS – Dr. Greger’s New Book ‘How Not To Diet’.
